limitations: This is a finite 12-pair-per-route A/A observation; no population false-positive rate or noise probability is estimated.
Phase components are independently summarized and are not additive after p50/p95/p99 reduction; phase ratios are descriptive, not causal attribution.
The original runner validation failure remains part of the result. The offline recovery validates evidence after that failure and cannot qualify a formal capture pass.
iWork is excluded from this DOCX A/A audit.

bootstrap.statistic: median of 12 paired ratios per route; nearest-rank 95% interval
